# Harpoon Fishing

Source: anothereden.wiki, page "Harpoon Fishing" (saved 2026-11-25, revision 342035, last edited
2026-09-15; the page adapts Anakan and Altema). Facts only, in our own words; no game art. The
saved page's image files were not added (copyright).

## How a catch works

- Added in v2.10.100 with the 3000 Realm Ark and the Sea Abyss. Fish are caught by tapping their
  silhouette with the harpoon, or by traps. Both raise the Proof of Harpoon Power (the fishing level).
- A catch needs enough **Proof level** and a fast enough **harpoon**. Bigger sizes and double or
  triple catches need more Proof than the minimum.
  - Proof too low: "the fish is too strong and the harpoon is flung away".
  - Harpoon too slow: "the fish nimbly dodged the harpoon". A better (faster) harpoon makes this
    miss rarer. Failing both shows the "too strong" message.
  - At a fish's minimum requirements the chance is low.
- Silhouette colour shows difficulty: blue, then yellow, then red. Sparkles on a silhouette mean a
  rare fish, which is harder to catch. Some silhouettes are horrors that must be defeated first.
- Silhouettes come back after 5 minutes; horror silhouettes after 1 hour.
- A shrimp spot on the minimap (a pot on the main screen) lets the player sprinkle bait (a large
  group of silhouettes) or set a trap there. The spot is then unusable for 1 hour. Bait kind sets the
  size and rarity of the fish. Traps can't catch rare fish, horrors or fish never caught by harpoon,
  and take 1 to 3 hours depending on the trap.
- Known bug (per the page): after a character with a jumping attack fought, fish can ignore taps;
  walking up or down a ramp, or leaving the room and returning, fixes it.

## Harpoon ladder

The free Normal Harpoon is upgraded in steps at the Catch Queen (Siren's Village) for Kamasu
Points: Normal, Flexible, Light, Nimble, Gust, Guardian, each in five levels (I-V). The page
says Gust Harpoon III to V is about the speed that catches most rare fish. The harpoon *tip* is a
separate upgrade (Fish Stones) that only raises the chance of double or triple catches (Normal Tip
III is the minimum for a double, Three Pronged Tip III for a triple).

## Sea of Ice (Another Dungeon, Very Hard)

- The pond has its own completion award (all its fish caught there at least once): 20 of the
  award currency. A fish caught in another pond doesn't count.
- One shrimp spot per run: bait or a trap, same timers as outside; a trap placed in one run can be
  picked up in a later run once its timer ends. Two horrors return in every new run.
- Fish listed for it include big uncommon ones (Heligulpter Eel, Rekifish, Freakoutapod: Proof 1)
  and rare ones: Homolamola Fish (Proof 22), Sweetsharks (Proof 23; the page's table seems to list
  Gust Harpoon IV as its harpoon, the layout of the saved page is unclear) and Broke Coelacanth
  (Proof 23). Treasure trades for the three rares
  are on the page (Stun Needle, Shark Saw, Super Dark Ink).
